blocks.arabic_text: حَرَّمَهُ اللهُ عَلَي النَّارِ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط الشيخين ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٧٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umar (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say: “I know a Kalimah. Whichever servant understands it in his heart to be true, says it (with his tongue), and dies in that same state, Allah will make the fire of Jahannam haram upon him. It is the Kalimah “La ilaha illallah’.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عِيَاضِ نِ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵁ رَفَعَهُ قَالَ: إِنَّ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ كَلِمَةٌ عَلَي اللهِ كَرِيمَةٌ لَهَا عِنْدَ اللهِ مَكَانٌ وَهِيَ كَلِمَةٌ مَنْ قَالَهَا صَادِقاً أَدْخَلَهُ اللهُ بِهَا الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا كَاذِباً حَقَنَتْ دَمَهُ وَأَحْرَزَتْ مَالَهُ وَلَقِيَ اللهَ غَدًا فَحَاسَبَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار ورجاله موثقون، مجمع الزوائد:١٧٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Iyad al-Ansari (RA) narrates: The Prophet ﷺ said that the blessed Kalimah “La ilaha illallah’ is most honoured with Allah. It has a very high rank with Allah. Whichever person says this Kalimah with a truthful heart, Allah will, because of it, make him enter Jannah. Whoever says this Kalimah with a false heart, it will protect his life and wealth (in this world). However, tomorrow (on the Day of Qiyamah) he will meet Allah. Then Allah will call him to account (about it).

blocks.text: Explanation:- Because he says the Kalimah with a false heart, he outwardly appears to be a Muslim. Therefore his life and wealth will be protected. He will not be killed like a kafir who fights against the Muslims. Nor will jizyah be collected from his wealth.
